overclaims: On February 12, 2026, Reuters described Anthropic as the only AI company available in classified settings through third parties, but could not establish plans for further deployments [e1].
checks.note: Excerpt, proposition, criteria, and the not_applicable/not_adjudicable outcome are fine. The rationale misstates e1: Reuters reported that the Pentagon was moving to deploy across classification levels and only 'could not determine how or when'. It did not fail to establish the plans themselves. The public evidence excerpts are cut to fragments ('Reuters could not determine', 'our agreement') rather than the recorded exact words. Dropping 'how or when' changes the meaning and supports the misreading.
